sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile), Wind Release, Fire Release

system.description:
You throw a single globe flame onto a point you can see in range, that then explodes with extreme heat, in a 20-foot radius centered on the chosen point forcing all creatures in range to make a Dexterity saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creatures take half of 2d12 fire damage.

Success: Affected creatures take half of 2d12 fire damage and are Weakened until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures take 2d12 fire damage and are overwhelmed by the flash fire causing them to be Burned.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but affected creatures are also Weakened.

Scorch. By spending 2 Scorch Charges, this jutsu’s method of application can become a melee ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + this jutsu’s damage on a hit, then forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw instead of a Dexterity save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the damage by 1d12.
